title: Moroccan Christmas
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office celebrates a Moroccan-themed Christmas party organized by Phyllis, leading to conflicts over decorations and secrets, including Angela's affair with Dwight. Meanwhile, Dwight attempts to profit from popular unicorn dolls, and Michael struggles to intervene in Meredith's alcoholism, facing resistance and uncertainty about her recovery. Toby negotiates to buy a doll for his daughter, and the office navigates holiday interactions amid personal tensions and revelations.

main_threads.thread: The Moroccan-themed Christmas party causes tension, especially between Phyllis and Angela, with Phyllis enforcing the theme by removing non-themed decorations and threatening to reveal Angela's affair with Dwight as leverage.

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: This is the first Christmas party I am throwing as head of the party planning committee. The theme is "Nights in Morocco".
Phyllis: Angela. You're going to move this for the party right? It's not on theme.
Angela: I am not going to judge Phyllis for desecrating Christmas. There is one person who will though and Phyllis just stuffed him into a drawer.
Phyllis: Oh, I don't think it's blackmail. Angela just does what I ask her to do so I won't tell everyone that she's cheating on Andy with Dwight.
Phyllis: Okay. Angela's having sex with Dwight.

main_threads.thread: Michael's intervention for Meredith's alcoholism unfolds with Meredith denying her addiction, admitting instead to a porn addiction, and resisting rehab, while the office debates how to support her and Michael plans to push her to hit rock bottom.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I am not asking her to stop drinking. I am imploring her to quit being an alcoholic.
Meredith: I'm not an alcoholic.
Andy: When I was in college I used to get wicked hammered. My nickname was puke. I would chug a fifth of socos, sneak into a frat party, polish off a few people's empties, some ...
Meredith: I don't mind telling you that I have an addiction. I do. To porn.
Michael (amid groans from the rest of the office): Alright, no, no, no. No. That is the image, I think we can all agree is very disgusting.
Meredith: No way! There is no way! No way!

main_threads.thread: Dwight capitalizes on the holiday toy craze by buying all the popular unicorn dolls to resell at a profit, while Toby negotiates with Darryl to buy a doll for his daughter, paying more than he has.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Every year I do research to determine which toy will be the most popular of the Christmas season. This year it's a doll. Half girl, half unicorn.
Toby: Hey, I'd like to buy one of your dolls.
Darryl: All right man, don't cry. It's cool. I'll let you get it for $400.
I just– I need it more than anything in this world. I need this doll. Darryl, man I need this doll.
